│   ◷ Backups            ││                                                                                            │
│   ⚑ Alerts             ││      Kind of vacuum                                                                        │
│   ↺ Restore            ││       ◉ Complete (FULL, ANALYZE; services stop)    ○ Full (services stop)                  │
│   ↶ Rollback           ││       ○ Plain (services keep running)    ○ Plain + ANALYZE (services keep running)         │
│   ✎ Fine-tune          ││       ○ ANALYZE only (fastest)                                                             │
